_readme: Hand-entered licensed figures (model v5.0), used for non-commercial purposes while permission requests are pending. Update after each new CoStar quarterly San Francisco Bay Area multifamily report (cap, vac, vacChg, rent) and each MLS monthly report for Santa Clara County (mos). Delete a value to fall back to the free public measure for that slot.

cap.detail: Average for all San Francisco Bay Area apartment buildings (CoStar), up from 5.5% a year ago. Newer, high-end buildings sell at about 4.25–4.65%, which is below the Treasury yield.

vac.detail: Apartment vacancy across the San Francisco Bay Area (CoStar). A year ago it was 4.8%.

rent.detail: Average asking apartment rent across the San Francisco Bay Area is $2,910 a month (CoStar).

supplyP.detail: Single-family homes in Santa Clara County had 1.6 months of supply (MLS data). Condos are slower, at 4.1 months. 31% of listings have cut their price (Realtor.com, September).
